'''Maeric''' was an [[Aiel]] warrior who led the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]] ''[[Seia Doon]]''.

== Appearance ==
He had a blocky figure.

== History ==
He was married to [[Dyrele]] and had a son called [[Darin]] and a daughter called [[Suraile]].

== Activities ==
He had aspirations of traveling to [[Rhuidean]] to become the next [[clan chief]] of the Shaido. He fought in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. He, with part of his sept, were dispersed through a [[Gateway]] near the Plains of [[Maredo]]. He ran into one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces and probably didn't survive the exchange.
